items.text: Ahoj! = Hi! / Bye!
items.picture: On a sunny university courtyard, Emma meets Lucia and Tomáš, who are walking up together. All three greet each other casually, hands raised.

items.text: Dobrý deň. = Hello. (polite)
items.picture: Emma walks into a small bakery. The baker, crouching to stock a low shelf of loaves, looks up and greets her.

items.text: Emma walks into a bakery. What does she say?
Dobré ráno. = Good morning.
items.picture: Early morning on a Bratislava street, low sun. Emma, holding a takeaway coffee, meets pani Horváthová walking to the university with a briefcase. They greet each other.

items.text: Dobrý večer. = Good evening.
items.picture: Evening on the street outside the dormitory, streetlamps lit. Emma, coming home, greets an older neighbour and her small grandson walking past.

items.text: Dovidenia. = Goodbye. (polite)
items.picture: Emma leaves the bakery with a paper bag of rolls, turning in the doorway to say goodbye to the baker.

items.text: Dobrú noc. = Good night.
items.picture: Late at night outside a cinema, under a streetlamp, Emma and Lucia part ways, waving good night to each other.

items.text: Dobrú chuť! = Enjoy your meal!
items.picture: In the university canteen, Emma, carrying her lunch tray, passes pani Horváthová eating at a table and wishes her a good meal.

items.text: It's late and Lucia is going to bed. What do you say?
items.picture: Late at night in Emma and Lucia's dorm room, moon in the window. Lucia, in pyjamas and yawning, is getting into bed.

items.text: Ďakujem. = Thank you.
items.picture: In the bakery, the baker hands Emma a paper bag of rolls across the counter. Emma takes it with a grateful smile.

items.text: Prosím. = Please. / You're welcome.
items.picture: Emma holds the dormitory door open for pani Horváthová, who carries a stack of books. Both smile: she has just said thank you and Emma is answering.

items.text: Nech sa páči. = Here you go.
items.picture: On a busy tram, Emma stands up and offers her seat to an elderly lady with a walking stick and a heavy bag.

items.text: Marek puts a plate of food in front of you. What does he say?
items.picture: Marek, in his chef's jacket, sets a steaming plate of halušky on a restaurant table in front of the viewer, smiling.

items.text: Áno, prosím. = Yes, please.
items.picture: In the dorm kitchen, Tomáš holds up a coffee pot with raised eyebrows; Emma nods eagerly and holds out her mug.

items.text: Tomáš offers you a coffee, but you don't want one. What do you say?
Prepáčte! = Sorry! / Excuse me!
items.picture: In the university canteen, Emma turns with her tray and bumps into Tomáš, who is carrying his. His glass of juice tips over and spills. Emma looks apologetic.

items.text: Nič sa nestalo. = That's OK. / No problem.
items.picture: In the canteen, Tomáš mops up the spilled juice with a napkin and waves it off with a smile; Emma still looks sheepish.

items.text: Emma bumps into pán Kováč in the corridor. What does she say?
items.picture: In the dormitory corridor, Emma hurries round a corner and almost collides with pán Kováč; both step back in surprise.

items.text: Na zdravie! = Cheers! / Bless you!
items.picture: Two halves for the two meanings. Left: Emma, Lucia and Tomáš clink glasses of kofola at a pub table. Right: Tomáš sneezes into a tissue while Lucia turns to him.

items.text: Tomáš sneezes. What do you say?
items.picture: On a train, Tomáš sneezes into a tissue; Emma, in the seat next to him, turns towards him.

items.text: Ako sa máš? = How are you?
items.picture: Emma at a tram stop, smiling into her phone as she asks a friend how they are.

items.text: Mám sa dobre, a ty? = I'm fine, and you?
items.picture: One of three linked pictures of Tomáš on the same park bench, with the weather matching his mood. This one: partly cloudy, he sits relaxed with a content smile.

items.text: Mám sa výborne. = I'm great.
items.picture: Tomáš on the same park bench in bright sunshine, beaming, an ice cream in hand.

items.text: Mám sa zle. = I'm not doing well.
items.picture: Tomáš on the same park bench in pouring rain, no umbrella, soaked and gloomy.

items.text: Ako sa voláš? = What's your name?
items.picture: At a student welcome party, Lucia turns to Emma, a new face, with a friendly, curious look, a drink in her hand.

items.text: Volám sa Emma. = My name is Emma.
items.picture: At the welcome party, Emma introduces herself, a hand on her chest, a blank name sticker on her cardigan.

items.text: Teší ma. = Nice to meet you.
items.picture: Emma and Tomáš shake hands warmly; Lucia, beside them, has just introduced them.

items.text: Tomáš says “Teší ma.” What do you answer?
Two ways to say “you”
items.picture: Split picture. Left: Emma chats with Lucia on the dorm sofa, relaxed, feet tucked up. Right: Emma talks with pani Horváthová in her office, standing upright and polite.

items.text: Emma meets pani Horváthová, her teacher. Which question fits?
Emma meets Lucia and Tomáš together. How does she ask how they are?
Lucia says “Dobrú noc!” What does Emma answer?
You meet pani Horváthová early in the morning. What do you say?
Which one means “Hi, everyone!”?
